name: Shell Spin

card.plain: Spin in your shell: projectiles pass through you while it lasts.
Lv 1 → Lv 2: Shell Spin recovers 4 frames faster, so a blocked spin costs less.
card.frames: Lv 1 → Lv 2: recovery -4 (10 / 18 / 16 frames), 80 damage, projectile-invulnerable while spinning

2.notes: Proposed (open question, A4). Changes how you fight: an 18-frame active window means the Kappa spins into blocked strings; 16 recovery frames makes a blocked or whiffed spin much less of a free punish, so it can be used as a read through a fireball and then followed up. Data only: the last 4 frames of the eased-out recovery are cut from the clip. Alternatives if the designer prefers: active -4 (shorter spin, less cover against projectiles) or startup -2 (the clip would need a new curve, F2). Overlap to decide: Brute Recovery already takes 4 recovery frames off on block.

card.plain: The spin surges forward on a torrent of water and hits several times.
card.frames: 10 / 18 / 16 frames, 80 damage x 3 hits, travels forward 180 units

notes: Clip kappa-shell-spin (GREYBOX heavy-swing stand-in: kappa-heavy-punch's Right_Uppercut_from_Guard retimed to 48 frames, 0.5x through the active frames, hit 11-28; route A on YOK-219, decision 4): 10/18/20 = the rules.md row exactly, no deviation, so no amendment. The stand-in reads as a slow uppercut, not a spin: the real take is clip_needs S07 and needs its own measure. Invulnerable to projectiles on the active frames 11-28 (properties.invuln against projectile); strikes and throws still hit it, since the table says only 'spins through projectiles'. Hitbox is a wide body-height box around the shell, x -70 to 160, y 40-280, so it also catches a cross-up; estimated for the Kappa (310 units tall), not re-placed from the posed rig. Damage 80 = table; hitstun 24, blockstun 18, strength medium are placeholders. One connect at Lv 1. Slot D (22 / down) for the Kappa's rare, as Fox Mirage and Oni Quake: a proposal, rules.md names no slot. Locked (A11, the diamond). EX (C5, E16) first pass, my proposal: +30% damage and a knockdown, as Oni Quake. Lv 3 Torrent Spin = rules table, travels forward and multi-hit: forward_travel 180 (10 units per tick over the active frames, stops at the push box, YOK-221) and multi_hit 3 hits 6 frames apart, 80 damage each (240 total if all connect). BALANCE FLAG for the designer and sparring-partner: three full hits is 3x Lv 1's damage for a Lv 3 move; if that is too much, the one-line fix is a damage mul_pct 60 effect in the same evolution. multi_hit and forward_travel are both read by the fight code (multi_hit since YOK-226, Match.Reaction.cs). Lv 3 keeps the Lv 2 step (E17). Undertow: River Grab -> Shell Spin is the GDD example; a cancel's target needs no window on this move. Presets shell-spin-lv1, shell-spin-lv2 and torrent-spin are named, files are Asset Smith's.
